description: List an agent's conversation sessions, newest first: each one's id, status, title, message count, and when it was last updated. Pass a session id to get_session to read one, or to destroy_session to delete it. Titles come from what users said to the agent and may hold personal data: quote only what the person's question needs. Pass include conversation_key to add each session's conversation key, such as a chat id on another service; without it the key is left out. Sessions belong to agents; a website or app has none. Requires connecting a Valet account.

include.description: conversation_key adds each session's conversation key, such as a Telegram chat id. Without it the key is left out.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_sessions

agent.description: Name of the agent the sessions belong to.

more.description: True when the agent has more sessions than this list holds.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

sessions.description: The agent's sessions, newest first. Empty when it has none.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel the session came through. Empty for a session opened outside a channel.

conversation_key.description: Identifies the conversation on its channel, such as a chat id on another service. Present only when the call asked for it with include.

created_at.description: When the session started, as a UTC timestamp like 2026-01-02T15:04:05Z.

id.description: The session's id. Pass it as session to get_session or destroy_session.

message_count.description: How many messages the session holds.

status.description: idle, or running while the agent is mid-turn. destroy_session refuses a running session.

title.description: The session's title, drawn from what users said to the agent. Empty when it has none. May hold personal data.

updated_at.description: When the session last changed, as a UTC timestamp like 2026-01-02T15:04:05Z.

title: List an agent's sessions
